title: DK ladder-shape diagnostic (test 1, no outcomes)
outcome_text: report; run test 3 at low prior

prior.season: 2023-24 raw box scores (no 2022-23 box scores exist in this repository)

notes: No game outcomes anywhere in this diagnostic.
Shape score from raw box scores only; the league VMR prior by method of moments on 2023-24 (no 2022-23 box scores in the repository).
Implied tail P is DraftKings' raw Over price (margin included); the regression models the ladder shape DK publishes, not fair odds.
Games split in half at random (seed 20261018); residuals and correlations are read on the holdout half only.
